name: Snow Report 2026-11-24 05:00:00
report:
New snow overnight! 1 inch in the last 12 hours with a little more to fall in the early AM. Temps will be in the mid-20s with 5-10 mph winds from the west. Be sure to check out the whole mountain as the American Flyer is open along with the American Eagle and Easy Rider! 

Keep an eye on our Terrain Updates channel on Instagram for opening alerts. Our crews are out there now hard at work filling our trails with snow. 

A friendly reminder that early-season conditions are still in play. Ski and ride in control, stay aware of changing surfaces and conditions, and give each other plenty of space.

Hope to see you out there!

name: Snow Report 2026-11-23 05:00:00
report:
Exciting news...the Flyer is expected to open today providing access to High Point and Loverly! Our crews are out there now hard at work putting the finishing touches on the trails, so keep an eye on our Terrain Updates channel on Instagram for an opening alert.

For today's weather, expect mostly cloudy skies as another storm heads our way. Temperatures will hover in the mid-20s, with light winds and a chance for snow starting around midday. We could pick up a couple inches of fresh snow by the time the lifts stop spinning this afternoon!

A friendly reminder that early-season conditions are still in play. Ski and ride in control, stay aware of changing surfaces and conditions, and give each other plenty of space.

Hope to see you out there!

name: Snow Report 2026-11-22 05:02:06
report:
Happy Football Sunday, Copper Mountain!

We received 2 inches of new snow in the last 24 hours, all of which fell during the day yesterday. With a fresh layer of snow on the mountain, we can look forward to some soft, corduroy turns this morning!

Today, expect cooler temperatures, with a high near 25°F at the Aerie. Southwest winds will remain light to moderate throughout the day, with gusts reaching into the upper 20 mph range.

Yesterday we opened our first beginner terrain of the season, including the Easy Rider carpet and learning area! If you're heading out for your first few days on the slopes, this is a great place to get comfortable and find your ski or snowboard legs again. As we continue to expand terrain throughout the season, stay up to date by following our Copper Mountain Terrain Updates channel on Instagram.

Looking ahead to Thanksgiving, JJ's will be hosting a Thanksgiving dinner buffet this Thursday! The menu looks delicious, so be sure to make your reservations by emailing jjs@coppercolorado.com.

Enjoy the soft snow, have a great Sunday, and we'll see you on the mountain!

name: Snow Report 2026-11-21 05:00:42
report:
YAY SNOW DAY!

Copper Mountain received 4 inches of natural snow!!!
Weather during the day looks chilly with temps staying under 20 degrees, winds in the 10 mph range with gust as high as 30 mph from the W/NW direction. Snow precipitation will fizzle out by noon with cloudy coverage most of the day.

Easy Rider surface lift and associated terrain will open up today, this will be our only beginner terrain!
We still have limited trails open, so please stay in boundaries and snow in a matter that is safe for early season. 
 

Thank a snowmaker and enjoy some POWDER TURNS!

Stay up-to-date with terrain openings by using the Terrain Alerts Channel on the Copper Mountain Instagram.

name: Snow Report 2026-11-20 05:00:00
report:
Happy Friday!

Our snowmaking crews have been working hard to refresh our trails and with a chance of snow flurries throughout the day, we are looking at some great skiing and riding. Today you can expect cloudy skies with temps into the high-20s. Winds will be high around 20-30 mph from the southwest, gusting into the 50s.

Stay up-to-date with terrain openings by using the Terrain Alerts Channel on the Copper Mountain Instagram. Our next update on there will be tomorrow with the Easy Rider surface lift and associated terrain. Remember to always ski and ride in control, stay aware of those around you, and respect all posted signs, closures, and ropes. Get out there and enjoy making turns!

name: Snow Report 2026-11-19 05:00:00
report:
Happy Thursday!

No new snow overnight but our snowmaking crews have been at it refreshing our trails and the surface is looking great. Today you can expect mostly sunny skies with a high of 34 F. Winds will be coming from the south at 10 mph with gusts up to 25 mph.

Chance for snow tonight. In the meantime, get out there and enjoy making turns! Remember to always ski and ride in control, stay aware of those around you, and respect all posted signs, closures, and ropes.

name: Snow Report 2026-11-18 05:00:00
report:
Good morning from Copper Mountain!

1" of new snow to report this morning, falling after close yesterday afternoon.  While we'll need more help from Mother Nature to really get things going, we'll take it. Expect skies to clear this morning giving way to sunny skies, and temps in the high 20s at mid-mountain. Breezy WSW winds will accompany that sunshine with gusts around 40 mph later today.  Snow returns later this week and should continue off and on for several days.

Our snowmaking and slope maintenance teams continue to work hard to expand open terrain while we eagerly wait for more snowfall. In the meantime, get out there and enjoy making turns! Remember to always ski and ride in control, stay aware of those around you, and respect all posted signs, closures, and ropes.

Have a great Wednesday!

name: Snow Report 2026-11-17 05:00:00
report:
Good morning from Copper Mountain!

Today's forecast calls for partly sunny skies with increasing clouds as a storm approaches. Temperatures will reach the upper 30s to low 40s, accompanied by light southerly winds. Snow is expected this evening, with the potential for up to 1 to 2 inches of new snow. We're also keeping an eye on the forecast for a possibly stronger storm this weekend!

Our snowmaking and slope maintenance teams continue to work hard to expand open terrain while we eagerly wait for more snowfall. In the meantime, get out there and enjoy making turns! Remember to always ski and ride in control, stay aware of those around you, and respect all posted signs, closures, and ropes.

Hope to see you on the mountain!

name: Snow Report 2026-11-16 05:00:00
report:
Good Morning and welcome back to another week at Copper Mountain! We've got some sun ahead of us today with a high near 50° and calm winds. 

Crews have been working around the clock getting more of the mountain prepped while we wait for snow, So be sure to thank a snowmaker for making this early season possible! In the meantime please be respectful of all closures, be mindful of your speed and remember that the season is just getting started. We'll see you out there!

name: Snow Report 2026-11-15 05:00:00
report:
Mother nature delivered 1 in of new snow in the past 24 hours, however no new snow overnight so keep doing your snow dance whatever that may be. 

Today's forecast calls for partly cloudy skies with a high of 42F. Winds will be cruising in from the west-southwest at about 5 to 10 mph, with gusts up to 15. 

A friendly reminder to keep your heads on a swivel, your speed in check and give your fellow skiers and plenty of room.
